document_np: शासकीय सुधार सम्बन्धी एक सय कार्यसूचीहरू
document_en: One Hundred Agenda Items Related to Administrative Reform
venue_en: Singha Durbar, Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
description: 100 governance reform agendas approved by the first cabinet meeting of the Balendra Shah government. These represent concrete action items with deadlines, many implementing RSP manifesto commitments.
date_note: The official document header says 'Chaitra 13' (approved date) while Kantipur reported 'Chaitra 14' (publication date). Both dates are recorded.

sections.title_en: Shared Commitment, Coordination, and Public Trust
Public Service Delivery and Complaint Management
sections.title_np: सार्वजनिक सेवा प्रवाह र गुनासो व्यवस्थापन

sections.title_en: Digital Governance, Data Governance, and Communication
sections.title_np: डिजिटल शासन र डाटा गभर्नेन्स तथा सञ्चार

sections.title_en: Good Governance, Transparency, and Corruption Control
Public Procurement and Project Management Reform
sections.title_np: सार्वजनिक खरिद र परियोजना व्यवस्थापन सुधार

sections.title_en: Investment, Industry, Private Sector Promotion, and Tourism
sections.title_np: लगानी, उद्योग, निजी क्षेत्र प्रवर्द्धन तथा पर्यटन
कृषि, भूमि, पूर्वाधार र आधारभूत सेवा

sections.title_en: Other Strategic and Social Security Decisions
sections.title_np: अन्य रणनीतिक तथा सामाजिक सुरक्षा सम्बन्धी निर्णयहरू

agendas.title_en: Appreciation to Karki Government, Election Commission, Security Agencies, and Media
agendas.summary_en: Express gratitude to Sushila Karki government, Election Commission, security agencies, civil servants, journalists, and media for successful Falgun 21 election.

agendas.title_en: Delivery-Based Governance System — Ministry KPIs Within 7 Days
agendas.summary_en: Implement delivery-based governance. Each ministry prepares top 10 activities with timelines, responsible officers, KPIs within 7 days. Monthly progress to PM Office. Regular monitoring and public reporting.

agendas.title_en: Synthesize All Party Manifestos into National Commitment
agendas.summary_en: Synthesize implementable issues from all parties' manifestos and pledges into 'National Commitment' with GoN shared ownership. Link to annual policies, budgets, reform agendas. Establish structure under PM Office immediately.

agendas.title_en: Constitutional Amendment Debate Panel Task Force
agendas.summary_en: Form task force within 7 days to prepare Constitutional Amendment Debate Panel for national consensus on political/institutional reforms and electoral system. Process to be participatory, transparent, fact-based.

agendas.title_en: Formal State Apology to Dalit and Excluded Communities
agendas.summary_en: Within 15 days, formally acknowledge injustice faced by Dalits and historically excluded communities. Declare reform-oriented programs with formal state apology for social justice, inclusive restoration, and historical reconciliation.

agendas.title_en: Gen-Z Movement Victims — Integrated Justice and Rehabilitation Package
agendas.summary_en: Integrated initiative for Gen-Z (Bhadra 23-24) affected families. Within 100 days: employment, skill development, psychosocial counseling, rehabilitation package. Advance prosecution based on Gauri Bahadur Karki Commission report.

agendas.title_en: High-Level Inquiry Committee for Bhadra 24 Incident
agendas.summary_en: Form high-level inquiry committee within 1 week to investigate the Bhadra 24, 2082 incident. Collect details, analyze, identify responsible parties, submit report within specified timeframe. Advance further action based on recommendations.

agendas.title_en: Implement Commission Reports — Start Legal Processes Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Initiate legal, administrative, and prosecution processes within 30 days to implement recommendations from various commission reports that have remained unimplemented.

agendas.title_en: Reduce Federal Ministries to 17 Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Amend Government Work Division Regulations within 30 days to reduce ministries to 17. Manage staffing without affecting service delivery. Establish Restructuring Management Secretariat under PM Office for Transition Roadmap.

agendas.title_en: Business Process Re-engineering — Max 3 Approval Levels
agendas.summary_en: All public bodies review procedures, remove duplication, limit approval levels to max 3. BPR to make service delivery simple, fast, result-oriented. Standards and monitoring systems within 30 days.

agendas.title_en: Evaluate and Abolish Unproductive Boards/Committees
agendas.summary_en: Form high-level task force (PM Office, Finance, Industry, Federal Affairs ministries) to evaluate unproductive boards, committees, and projects for abolition, integration, or restructuring. Report within 1 month.

agendas.title_en: End Political Interference in Administration, Abolish Party Trade Unions
agendas.summary_en: Free public administration from political interference. Mandatory non-affiliation for civil servants, teachers, professors. Abolish party trade unions in administration. Federal Civil Service Bill within 45 days.

agendas.title_en: Implement Civil Service Code of Conduct Strictly
agendas.summary_en: Strictly implement Civil Service Code of Conduct. Make civil servants accountable, service-oriented, and exemplary. Ensure environment of impartiality and professional dignity.

agendas.title_en: National Standards for Organization & Management Survey
agendas.summary_en: Prepare and approve national standards for organization and management survey of federal, provincial, and local levels within 15 days.

agendas.title_en: Teacher Post-Retirement Management to Provincial Level
agendas.summary_en: Transfer teachers' system discharge and post-retirement service management to provincial education ministry starting next fiscal year.

agendas.title_en: Performance-Based Accountability (KPIs in 45 Days, Review System in 90)
agendas.summary_en: Each public body prepares objective performance indicators for every position within 45 days. Performance-linked accountability and review system within 90 days.

agendas.title_en: Service Quality Certification Standards for Local Level
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Federal Affairs prepares quality certification standards for local-level services within 45 days. Incentivize excellent bodies.

agendas.title_en: Uniform Standards for Government Office Infrastructure
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Urban Development prepares uniform standards for government office physical infrastructure within 2 months, implements within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: Personnel Management Information System (PMIS)
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Federal Affairs prepares PMIS architecture within 3 months for automated, predictable appointment, posting, transfer, promotion, and retirement management.

agendas.title_en: Citizen Service Centers — 12-Hour Operation in Major Cities
agendas.summary_en: Operate agency/office model citizen service centers in major cities with minimum 12 hours daily operation to end requirement of visiting multiple offices.

agendas.title_en: Digital Citizenship, Passport, NID — Any District, Faceless, Time-Bound
agendas.summary_en: Digitize and integrate citizenship, passport, NID services. Citizenship copies and passports from any district. Ward-level digital recommendation. NID as mandatory single ID. All processes faceless, time-bound, trackable.

agendas.title_en: Train All Front Desk Staff on All Services
agendas.summary_en: All offices submit front desk staff training needs within 15 days. Ministry arranges training within 6 months.

agendas.title_en: Time and Motion Study for Every Office Within 1 Month
agendas.summary_en: Each office conducts Time and Motion study within 1 month and prepares Restructuring Plan to make all processes digital, trackable, transparent.

agendas.title_en: 24/7 National Citizen Helpline and Complaint System
agendas.summary_en: Operate 24-hour National Citizen Assistance and Complaint Management System. Multi-channel: phone, mobile app, portal, social media.

agendas.title_en: Upgrade Hello Government — Real-Time Complaint Dashboard
agendas.summary_en: Upgrade Hello Government mechanism as citizen dialogue platform. Real-time monitoring of complaint resolution via integrated dashboard coordinating all ministries.

agendas.title_en: Predictable Time for Passport, Citizenship, License — Faceless Digital
agendas.summary_en: Make passport, citizenship, driver's license available in predictable time, intermediary-free. Transform all service processes to free, time-bound, faceless, digital.

agendas.title_en: Government Courier Service — Documents Delivered Home Within 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Modernize postal/courier to deliver government documents (passport, citizenship copies, licenses) to citizens' homes. Implement within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: Strengthen GIOMS in All Government Bodies Within 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Strengthen and make user-friendly existing GIOMS (Government Integrated Office Management System) in all government bodies at all levels within 100 days for fast, transparent, paperless service.

agendas.title_en: Auto-Fill Citizen Data Across Government Systems Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Implement auto-fill of citizen personal details (name/address from citizenship number) across government offices within 60 days. Once-only data submission principle.

agendas.title_en: Accessible Government Apps for Disabilities Within 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Make government apps and portals usable by persons with disabilities and citizens with limited technical knowledge within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: Citizen App for Police Report, Passport, License Applications
agendas.summary_en: Enable applications for police reports, passports, and driver's licenses through Citizen App within 45 days. Local form storage (not centralized). Auto-fill from stored/linked data.

agendas.title_en: Appointment Booking System for Government Services
agendas.summary_en: Within 3 months, implement appointment booking system for services requiring physical presence. Citizens choose convenient date/time.

agendas.title_en: NID-Based Digital Signature via Biometric/OTP
agendas.summary_en: Enable e-signature via NID Card, Biometric, or OTP instead of certificate-only digital signature. Strengthen NID department. Study and report within 1 month under Home Ministry coordination.

agendas.title_en: File Tracking with Auto-Alert for Delays Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Within 30 days, implement file tracking in GIOMS that monitors how long files stay on each desk and auto-alerts superior officers when time limits are exceeded.

agendas.title_en: Downloadable Certificates via App/Email Within 15 Days
agendas.summary_en: Within 15 days, enable citizens to download certificates through official mobile app/Citizen App or email.

agendas.title_en: National Integrated Digital Governance Platform — Data Exchange in 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Establish National Integrated Digital Governance Platform. Adopt 'submit once' principle. Integrate all government data/services. Begin National Data Exchange Platform based on digital public infrastructure within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: Digital Governance and Data Protection Law Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare policies and laws for digital governance and personal data protection within 60 days to enable single-platform service delivery, transparency, and reduced time/cost.

agendas.title_en: Independent IT Regulatory Authority Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Make legal and institutional arrangements within 60 days for establishing an Independent Regulatory Authority for IT and digital governance.

agendas.title_en: IT and E-Governance Office Under PM Office Within 3 Months
agendas.summary_en: Establish IT and E-Governance Office under PM Office within 3 months. Abolish current IT Department. All IT-related public bodies to operate under this new office.

agendas.title_en: IT and E-Governance Bill Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare the Information Technology and E-Governance Bill within 60 days.

agendas.title_en: National Enterprise Architecture Framework Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare the National Enterprise Architecture Framework within 60 days.

agendas.title_en: Shut Down Betting Apps Within 24 Hours
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Communication and IT shall shut down betting apps and related websites within 24 hours.

agendas.title_en: Asset Inquiry Committee Within 15 Days — Officials Since 2062 BS
agendas.summary_en: Form empowered Asset Inquiry Committee under PM Office within 15 days. Phase 1: investigate assets of political office holders and high officials from 2062/63 to present. Phase 2: from 2048 to 2061/62. Include law, finance, revenue experts.

agendas.title_en: Restructure National Vigilance Center Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare and implement restructuring plan for National Vigilance Center within 30 days for good governance, corruption control, transparency, and accountability.

agendas.title_en: Integrated Digital Asset Registry — NRB Within 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Nepal Rastra Bank establishes Integrated Digital Asset Registry within 100 days covering bank accounts, digital wallets, shares, financial assets. Risk-Based Red Flag system. Auto-identify suspicious transactions.

agendas.title_en: Second National Anti-Corruption Action Plan Within 15 Days
agendas.summary_en: Issue Second National Action Plan against Corruption within 15 days, aligned with UN Convention against Corruption.

agendas.title_en: National Integrity Policy, Whistleblower Protection Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Issue National Integrity Policy within 30 days for integrity promotion, whistleblower protection, and conflict of interest management. Advance related law preparation.

agendas.title_en: Amend Public Procurement Act — Digital, VFM, Performance-Based
agendas.summary_en: Amend Public Procurement Act within 30 days. Implement Value for Money, Life Cycle Costing, EGov Marketplace, Performance-Based Contracting. Fully digital, transparent, trackable procurement.

agendas.title_en: Project Management Reform (Pipeline, Sick Projects, Fast-Track, Infra Company)
agendas.summary_en: Multi-part: (a) NPC prepares National Project Pipeline within 2 months. (b) Study team for sick projects within 30 days. (c) Fast-Track Mechanism for national pride projects — direct PM Office monitoring. (d) Law within 3 days for government infrastructure company for failed tenders.

agendas.title_en: End-to-End E-Procurement Monitoring Within 90 Days
agendas.summary_en: Implement data-based end-to-end e-procurement monitoring system within 90 days to track from project selection to payment. Control variation order misuse and delays.

agendas.title_en: Project Facilitation Umbrella Law Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Draft umbrella law for Project Facilitation within 60 days to solve projects getting entangled in multiple laws and approvals for years.

agendas.title_en: Highway Project Directorate and Toll Plazas
agendas.summary_en: Immediately establish project directorates for major road/transport projects causing daily hardship. Install highway toll plazas within 45 days based on strategic area study.

agendas.title_en: Empower Single-Window Service Center at Industry Dept
agendas.summary_en: Delegate additional authority to staff at single-window service center in Department of Industry for simple, fast, transparent industry registration, approval, and operations.

agendas.title_en: National Structured Project Pipeline Within 90 Days
agendas.summary_en: NPC, Investment Board, and Ministry of Finance jointly classify all national pride and registered projects by investment modality (government/PPP/private/mixed) within 90 days. Publish National Structured Project Pipeline.

agendas.title_en: One Door Approval System Under Investment Board Within 1 Month
agendas.summary_en: Establish One Door Approval System under Investment Board Nepal within 1 month for integrated, time-bound services to domestic and foreign investors.

agendas.title_en: Startup Fast Track — Business Registration in 2 Days
agendas.summary_en: Implement Startup Fast Track system for simple, fast (within 2 days), hassle-free business registration to promote entrepreneurship.

agendas.title_en: Reduce Risk Weightage for SME, Agriculture, IT Loans — NRB 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Nepal Rastra Bank reduces risk weightage on loans to SME, agriculture, and IT sectors within 30 days.

agendas.title_en: One Door Business Platform Within 45 Days
agendas.summary_en: Integrate business registration, tax registration, bank account, and permits into One Door Business Platform within 45 days. Digital, transparent, trackable.

agendas.title_en: Employment, Skill, and Entrepreneurship Centers Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Transform employment service centers into Employment, Skill, and Entrepreneurship Centers within 60 days. Joint operation by CTEVT, Labor Ministry, Industry Ministry. Unemployed registration, skill mapping, returnee integration.

agendas.title_en: Private Sector Protection and Promotion Strategy (PSPP)
agendas.summary_en: Approve and immediately implement PSPP strategy for physical security, economic revival, regulatory simplification, investment promotion, and youth entrepreneurship.

agendas.title_en: Industrial/Business Security Rapid Response Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Home Affairs develops necessary structures and rapid response mechanisms for industrial and business security within 30 days.

agendas.title_en: Strict Legal Action for Damage to Private Property
agendas.summary_en: Security agencies immediately advance strict legal action against persons involved in damage, looting, and attacks on private property.

agendas.title_en: Subsidized and Rehabilitation Packages for Gen-Z Affected Businesses
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Finance and NRB issue subsidized and rehabilitation packages for businesses affected during Gen-Z movement.

agendas.title_en: PM Delivery Unit — Central KPI Dashboard
agendas.summary_en: Immediately establish PM Delivery Unit under PM Office for integrated, result-oriented tracking of investment, production, export, productivity. Central dashboard with KPIs, ministry tracking, obstacle resolution.

agendas.title_en: End Duplication Among Investment Board, Export Center, Industry Dept
agendas.summary_en: Form task force within 30 days to prepare roadmap for consolidating Investment Board Nepal, Trade & Export Promotion Center, Department of Industry into single-window service system.

agendas.title_en: Unified Small Industry Registration, No Fees — Within 45 Days
agendas.summary_en: Industries up to Rs 25 crore registered only through Trailu and Small Industry Offices. Abolish registration fees. End duplicate practices. Within 45 days.

agendas.title_en: Interoperability of Company/Industry/Commerce Data Within 2 Months
agendas.summary_en: Company Registrar, Industry Dept, Commerce Dept data interoperability within 2 months. Free consultation desk within 15 days. Real-time data system for all registered firms within 3 months.

agendas.title_en: Centralize CSR Funds into Government Priority Fund
agendas.summary_en: Centralize industrial CSR funds and channel to government-designated priority sectors. Complete necessary law amendments within 3 months.

agendas.title_en: Private Sector Protection — Security, Relief, Dialogue (Multi-Part)
agendas.summary_en: (a) Private Sector Protection Strategy immediately. (b) High-alert security for industries, supply chains. (c) Administrative facilitation for disrupted businesses. (d) Damage data collection, relief/subsidy packages. (e) Activate PM-chaired Industry-Commerce Dialogue Council.

agendas.title_en: Ensure Unobstructed Movement of Import/Export Goods
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Home Affairs immediately ensures import/export transport operates without obstruction in supply chain.

agendas.title_en: Clean Investment Environment — Auto-Approval, Beneficial Ownership, BEPS
agendas.summary_en: Ensure clean investment environment. Automated investment approval. Strict beneficial ownership disclosure. Implement BEPS international tax standards. Control capital flight and money laundering.

agendas.title_en: Tourism Framework for Koshi, Ramaroshan, Api/Dodi Himal Routes
agendas.summary_en: Study and present implementable tourism framework within 1 month for Udayapur (Koshi River), Achham (Ramaroshan), Bajura Badimalika, Api Himal and Dodi Himal trekking routes.

agendas.title_en: Wellness Tourism Strategy — Nepal Wellness Year 2027
agendas.summary_en: Issue wellness tourism strategy within 15 days. Thank all UN member states supporting April 15 International Wellness Day. Establish mechanism to observe Nepal Wellness Year 2027.

agendas.title_en: Energy Sector Development (Multi-Part: Export, PPA, NEA Reform)
agendas.summary_en: (a) Energy export strategy within 1 month. (b) Decide all pending PPAs and licenses within 180 days. (c) Focus exports on peak-hour high-price markets. (d) NEA structural reform roadmap immediately. (e) Multi-dimensional financing (govt, private, foreign, diaspora).

agendas.title_en: Integrated Drinking Water Coordination Task Force
agendas.summary_en: Form high-level task force under PM Office including Kathmandu Khanepani, Nepal Water Supply, and Water Supply Dept. Present integrated structure and reform proposal within 30 days.

agendas.title_en: Fewa Lake Watershed Protection Within 3 Months
agendas.summary_en: Remove encroachment from Fewa protected watershed area. Advance landslide management, lake conservation, and climate adaptation with stakeholder participation within 3 months.

agendas.title_en: Urban Development Bill and Waste Management Bill Within 2 Months
agendas.summary_en: Present Urban Development Bill and Waste Management Bill to Cabinet within 2 months for submission to Federal Parliament.

agendas.title_en: Recover Dormant Bank Accounts (10+ Years) Within 90 Days
agendas.summary_en: Collect details of bank/financial institution accounts inactive 10+ years. Bring unclaimed funds to state treasury after legal process. Identify other inactive state resources. Within 90 days.

agendas.title_en: Mandatory E-Billing for Large Businesses Within 1 Month
agendas.summary_en: Large businesses must implement e-billing system within 1 month for transparent, digital, effective revenue system.

agendas.title_en: Tax Automation and Revenue Leakage Control Plan Within 45 Days
agendas.summary_en: Ministry of Finance prepares and implements work plan within 45 days to automate tax administration, control revenue leakage, and simplify taxpayer services.

agendas.title_en: Consolidate 139+ Government Funds Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare framework within 60 days for integrating 139+ scattered/duplicate funds of similar nature and investing in high-return projects.

agendas.title_en: Mining Sector Reform — Cancel Inactive Licenses, Modernize Labs
agendas.summary_en: Cancel inactive mining licenses. Strictly regulate active firms. Amend Mines Act 2042 for investment-friendly, transparent rules. Begin installing modern lab equipment within 3 months. Build strategic minerals database.

agendas.title_en: Customs Reform — Trade Facilitation, MRP Enforcement
agendas.summary_en: Restructure customs for trade facilitation. Ensure effective commerce/consumer protection regulation. Mandate and precisely monitor Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in market.

agendas.title_en: Mobilize Dormant Court/Government Bail Deposits Within 60 Days
agendas.summary_en: Prepare legal basis within 60 days to mobilize large bail/deposit amounts held inactive in courts and government bodies for development.

agendas.title_en: Health Sector Reform (Multi-Part: Free Beds, Digital Records, Burn Wards, Air Ambulance)
agendas.summary_en: (a) Mandate 10% free beds in all hospitals; Free Health Portal within 30 days. (b) Digital patient record system within 3 months; clear referral protocol. (c) Hospital attendance/conduct/cleanliness audit within 1 week. (d) Digital pharmacy stock/price system within 3 months; Sulabh Pharmacies within 100 days. (e) Burn ward establishment process within 30 days. (f) Air ambulance standby in hilly regions immediately.

agendas.title_en: Remove Party Student Orgs, Create Student Council
agendas.summary_en: Remove party student organization structures from schools/universities within 60 days. Develop Student Council / Voice of Student mechanism within 90 days.

agendas.title_en: University Exam Results Per Ministry Calendar
agendas.summary_en: University bachelor's and master's exam results must be published per calendar provided by Ministry of Education, Science and Technology.

agendas.title_en: No Citizenship Required for Bachelor's Study
agendas.summary_en: Citizenship shall not be required for students studying up to bachelor's level. Universities shall immediately make procedural arrangements.

agendas.title_en: End Internal Exams for Grades 1-5 — Alternative Evaluation
agendas.summary_en: Discontinue internal examinations for students up to grade 5 from next academic session. Prepare alternative evaluation system without psychological pressure.

agendas.title_en: Agriculture Reform (Multi-Part: MSP, Cold Storage, Soil Health)
agendas.summary_en: (a) Begin minimum support price process for major crops within 30 days. (b) Mandatory 25-day payment for crop purchases; national ag market info system; weekly markets; 'One Municipality One Cold Storage' with feasibility study in 10 days. (c) Soil Health Cards for commercial farmers within 3 months.

agendas.title_en: Landless/Squatter Digital Registry — Solve Within 1000 Days
agendas.summary_en: Complete digital records of all landless squatters within 60 days. Solve problem within 1000 days. Household surveys, clear criteria (cut-off date, income, assets), GIS database of public/Guthi lands. Phased land provision or apartment model. Public dashboard for transparency.

agendas.title_en: Protect Public Land — Digital Records, Remove Encroachment
agendas.summary_en: Immediately begin digital records and monitoring for public land protection. Remove illegal encroachment. Strict prevention of new encroachment. Nepal Child Organization land investigation per Haribabu Commission within 15 days.

agendas.title_en: Amend Offense Property Regulations Within 2 Months
agendas.summary_en: Amend Offense-wise Property (Seizure, Control, Confiscation) Regulations within 2 months to simplify and streamline process.

agendas.title_en: NPR 10 Million for CIB Technology Upgrade
agendas.summary_en: Immediately provide at least NPR 10 million (1 crore) to make Nepal Police CIB technology-enabled.

agendas.title_en: Inter-Ministry Task Force for Regional Crisis Impact (Middle East)
agendas.summary_en: Form inter-ministerial task force under Foreign Ministry within 30 days to study impact of international/regional crises (esp. Middle East) on economy, foreign employment, supply chains, energy. Report with policy measures within 7 days.

agendas.title_en: Auction/Manage Vehicles Stranded at Customs
agendas.summary_en: Immediately collect details of vehicles stranded at customs and arrange utilization, management, or auction.

agendas.title_en: Blue Bus Service in All 7 Provinces — 25 Buses in 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Operate free Blue Bus service for women's safety in all 7 provinces. Phase 1: at least 25 buses operational within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: CCTV/Dashcam in All Public Transport, SOS Button Within 30 Days
agendas.summary_en: Install CCTV/Dashcam in all public vehicles and mandate SOS Button in ride-sharing apps for gender-based violence prevention. Emergency info reaches police immediately. Complete within 30 days.

agendas.title_en: Cooperative Small Savers Refund Process Within 100 Days
agendas.summary_en: Begin process of refunding savings of small savers in cooperatives within 100 days.

agendas.title_en: Call for United National Commitment — All Stakeholders
agendas.summary_en: All government levels, constitutional bodies, security agencies, political parties, private sector, civil society, and development partners unite for citizen-oriented cooperation. Make necessary policy, structural, and programmatic arrangements. Appeal for active, coordinated, accountable roles.
